title.narrative: Addendum n°1 to contract IFS/2020/411-162 - Critical Maritime Routes Indo-Pacific II (CRIMARIO II)

description.narrative:
Based on Decisions NDICI THREATS FPI/2021/043-399 (AAP 2021) and NDICI THREATS FPI/2022/044-496 (AAP 2022)

Ammendments in:

  1. Geographical extension to the Pacific;
  2. Extension of the duration by 12 months;
  3. Update of the Description of Action, taking into account the two Decisions as well as the findings from the previous more than two years of operations;
  4. Top-up of the budget by additional EUR 10 million;
  5. Change of the project name: ¿Critical Maritime Routes Indo-Pacific¿. (The term ¿Indian Ocean¿ was replaced.)

Addendum 2 (July 2024):

  1. Top-up by additional EUR 500.000 for IORIS upgrade.
  2. Extension of the duration by 3 months, 2 day, until 31 July 2025.
  3. Adjustment of the DoA.
